sentences.text: Petitioner is the 4th accused in Crime No.3713 of 2013 of the Aluva East Police Station, Ernakulam District, which was registered alleging commission of offences under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Aluva East Police Station, Ernakulam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The allegation against the accused is that they physically and mentally harassed the de-facto complainant, who is the wife of the 1 st accused, by demanding dowry and thereby they committed the offences alleged against them.
2. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is the brother of the 1 st accused.
It is submitted that the petitioner had no occasion whatsoever to commit any offence as alleged against him.
It is submitted that the petitioner was working abroad and was not aware of the fact that a crime had been registered against him and that a final report had been filed in the matter.

It is submitted that though other relatives of the petitioner are also accused in the case, they are not on good terms with the petitioner and therefore, the petitioner was never informed of the fact that the case was CRL.MC NO. 8340 OF 2023 pending.
It is submitted that the petitioner came to know of the proceedings only when proceedings under Section 82 / 83 of the Cr.P.C were initiated against the petitioner.
It is submitted that the only prayer of the petitioner is to permit the petitioner to surrender before the Jurisdictional Court and seek bail.

3. Heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.
4.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations against the petitioner, I am of the view that the petitioner can be permitted to appear before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva in C.C.No.753 of 2014 and seek bail in that case.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The coercive proceedings against the petitioner can be kept in abeyance till a decision is taken on the bail application to be filed by the petitioner.

5. Accordingly, this Crl.M.C will stand disposed of directing that if the petitioner surrenders before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva in C.C.No.753 of 2014, within a period of ten days from today, any bail application that may be filed by the petitioner shall be considered and disposed of by that Court on the date of surrender itself.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The benefit of this order will CRL.MC NO. 8340 OF 2023 not be available to the petitioner unless he surrenders before the court below within the time specified above.
This Crl.M.C will stand disposed of as above.

Sd/-

opennyai_summary.facts:
Petitioner is the 4th accused in Crime No.3713 of 2013 of the Aluva East Police Station, Ernakulam District, which was registered alleging commission of offences under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The allegation against the accused is that they physically and mentally harassed the de-facto complainant, who is the wife of the 1 st accused, by demanding dowry and thereby they committed the offences alleged against them.
opennyai_summary.arguments: It is submitted that the petitioner had no occasion whatsoever to commit any offence as alleged against him.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations against the petitioner, I am of the view that the petitioner can be permitted to appear before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva in C.C.No.753 of 2014 and seek bail in that case.
The coercive proceedings against the petitioner can be kept in abeyance till a decision is taken on the bail application to be filed by the petitioner.
5. Accordingly, this Crl.M.C will stand disposed of directing that if the petitioner surrenders before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Aluva in C.C.No.753 of 2014, within a period of ten days from today, any bail application that may be filed by the petitioner shall be considered and disposed of by that Court on the date of surrender itself.
The benefit of this order will CRL.MC NO. 8340 OF 2023 not be available to the petitioner unless he surrenders before the court below within the time specified above.
This Crl.M.C will stand disposed of as above.
